answer: On a newcomer’s first claim, require a public heartbeat service to stay reachable for one full epoch; the verifier sends signed nonces at unpredictable times and withholds rewards until every reply comes from the same endpoint. Nonce labels rotate among mesa, cipher, and raven, so a canned response cannot pass; a missed ping restarts the probation. Proposed one-time setup cost: 0.75 POA per identity; 0.75 × 1,000 = 750 POA for 1,000 fake identities versus 0.75 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: a wealthy operator can still run many endpoints.
